name: Medical Special Care 2
source:
Several months after the events of the first game, the story continues — this time from the husband’s perspective.

He has received a promotion and now leads a new psychiatric department. The job keeps him busy, leaving less time for the people around him.

After an unusual first week at the hospital, he and his wife Eva visit a family therapist to improve their relationship and find a better balance between work and personal life.

Meanwhile, life at the hospital goes on. Karin continues working as a nurse while studying, and Lana and Dean enroll in the hospital’s university program.

The mysterious M.S.C. program, once known for its “special care” for patients, has been quiet lately… but not for long.

[From [url=https://10ki.itch.io/medical-special-care-2-v01g]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在第一款游戏的事件发生几个月后，故事仍在继续——这次是从丈夫的角度来看的。

他获得了晋升，现在领导一个新的精神科。工作让他很忙，留给周围人的时间越来越少。

在医院度过了不寻常的第一周后，他和妻子伊娃拜访了一位家庭治疗师，以改善他们的关系，并在工作和个人生活之间找到更好的平衡。

与此同时，医院的生活仍在继续。卡琳在学习的同时继续担任护士，拉娜和迪恩参加了医院的大学课程。

神秘的MSC该项目曾以对患者的“特殊护理”而闻名，但最近却一直沉寂……但时间不长。
